crossRefs.note: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.
Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled.…
A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
“Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I…
For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another;
Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away and the…
This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
“This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a…
But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one…
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
translations.bsb: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.
translations.kjv: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
translations.asv: And this is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he gave us commandment.
